headline: Autonomy went dark because the meter hit zero. The Oraya API org ran out of credits and Anthropic disabled the key on Aug 23 — so the ads watchdog, the cofounder sweep, meeting-ingest and two whole brief editions simply stopped, and the campaign has now run ~2 days with nobody watching the kill-gates. One bright signal in the wreckage: the booking funnel you kept asking for is finally live and counting — in test. Reload the credits and it all comes back on.

spotlight.title: Reload the Anthropic API credits — it's the master switch
spotlight.detail: At Aug 23 23:05Z Anthropic disabled the Oraya org's API key: "out of usage credits." That single event explains everything downstream — the FA-ADS watchdog has sent nothing since Aug 22 9:35 PM PT, the cofounder sweep and meeting-ingest stopped writing, and both the Aug 23 PM and Aug 24 editions never shipped (this brief only exists because it runs on a separate session). Add credits and turn on auto-reload so a $0 balance can never again silently switch off every autonomous lane at once. Until that's done, treat all autonomy as offline.

spotlight.title: The ads have run ~2 days unwatched — read Ads Manager by hand
spotlight.detail: With the watchdog dark, no kill-gate has been evaluated since Saturday. Last known-good read: $24.91 lifetime, CPL $0.40, six ads ACTIVE, every gate clear — but that is Aug 22's number. Open Ads Manager and eyeball spend, delivery, frequency and rejections across Aug 23-25 before trusting anything or funding more. If the credits get reloaded (spotlight 1) the watchdog resumes on its own; until then this is a manual read, and the Saturday shell-string email bug is still unfixed for when it restarts.

spotlight.title: The booking funnel is live and counting — validate it, then feed it real leads
spotlight.detail: The gap this brief has hammered for a week — "no CRM, cost-per-booked-call un-measurable" — just closed in test form. A new daily 'Oraya digest' (flashworkflow) is emitting the exact instrument we needed: Aug 25 shows 2 new in 24h, 4 booked, 15% booking rate, median reply 6 min, 22 SLA-breached, 1 opted-out — end-to-end through F·A Apex's "policy review" booking email. Caveat that keeps it honest: today's rows are test leads ("Launch Testlead", "Calfirst Testlead", CA, closed_lost). So the pipe works; it has never seen a real ad lead. Confirm the field mapping and the 5-minute SLA timer, then make sure the live Meta lead actually flows into it — that is what finally turns cost-per-booked-call into a real number.

blockers.detail: Root cause of the 3-day blackout. Anthropic disabled the Oraya org key Aug 23 23:05Z for a $0 balance. Watchdog, cofounder sweep, meeting-ingest and autoloop are all down until the balance is restored. Reload + enable auto-reload so this can't recur silently.
